item.title: Jack’s Old-Time Jam — Wed Nov 11, 5:00 PM — Jack Of The Wood
item.description:
Grab some dinner and a pint while enjoying our long-running Old-Time Jam! Featuring many talented musicians from the local WNC area, our traditional Appalachian mountain music jam runs from 5-9pm every Wednesday night at Jack of the Wood! Jack Of The Wood is still a downtown hot spot for food, brews and drink since 1997 and founders Joan and Joe Eckert who still own it, have maintained the original lively English and Irish vibe. The old-time mountain and Irish music jams continue, including a hot bluegrass jam Thursdays and brunch every Sunday. The venue extends a welcoming feeling to regulars and newcomers to this day. https://jackofthewood.com/
Source: LiveMusicAsheville.com

item.title: Jam > Grass > Jam: The Saylor Brothers — Wed Nov 11, 6:30 PM — French Broad River Brewery
item.description:
The Saylor Brothers are a jamgrass fusion group from Asheville, fronted by brothers Will & Ben Saylor, of Brushfire Stankgrass. This project is a foray further into the realm of bluegrass jam, with more emphasis on improvisation piled on top of a structure of traditional bluegrass and innovative original songwriting. As a trio with Greg Stiglets on bass, the band packs a large sound coming from three acoustic instruments, and often adds a fourth player for further improvisational and bluegrass firepower.
Jam > Grass > Jam is not an open bluegrass jam but is a residency featuring a rotating casts of special guests from Asheville’s bluegrass/jamband scene.
French Broad River Brewery is more than just a place to enjoy a drink—it’s a community hub where great beer, delicious pizza, live music, and good times come together. item.description: The Queen Sessions at Hotel Eve | A celebration of the legendary women who shaped jazz. Hotel Eve proudly presents The Queen Sessions, a concert series curated by Melissa McKinney, honoring the iconic voices that defined generations of jazz. Each Wednesday evening features a rotating lineup of Asheville’s premier vocalists, each bringing their own style, artistry, and interpretation to the music of legends like Ella Fitzgerald, Billie Holiday, Nina Simone, Sarah Vaughan, Dinah Washington, Abbey Lincoln, and more. item.title: Rattle Creek BBQ Food Truck — Fri Nov 13, 12:00 PM
item.description:
Rattle Creek BBQ is a smoked-meat food truck, bringing Cali-Mex meets Texas BBQ cooking to the mountains.
Before Asheville, owner Mat cooked in Austin, where he picked up a deep respect for low-and-slow brisket and a love for bright, fresh food creating the ultimate balanced meal. Rattle Creek’s menu includes BBQ plates, sandwiches, and tacos, featuring brisket, spare ribs, and pulled pork, plus sides like guajillo crunch slaw, elote corn salad, and queso mac & cheese.

item.title: Asheville Crokinole Club — Tue Nov 17, 6:00 PM — Taproom At Highland Brewing Co.
item.description:
Crokinole Tuesdays at Highland Brewing Taproom Join us every Tuesday in the Taproom for an evening of flicks, strategy, and friendly competition! We’re hosting the Asheville Crokinole Club—a community of players who love this classic dexterity board game. Never played? No problem! Crokinole is easy to learn and endlessly fun. Players take turns flicking wooden discs across a circular board, aiming for the high-scoring center zones. The twist? If your opponent has discs on the board, you must hit one—miss, and your piece is out! Whether you’re a seasoned pro or just curious, come grab a pint, meet new friends, and test your skills.
Source: Highland Brewing

item.title: Shut Up & Write - South Asheville — Sun Dec 6, 10:30 AM
item.description:
Shut Up & Write!® Western North Carolina Coworking for writers in your area! Join us for some focused writing time. All writers and all experience levels are welcome and don’t worry, no one will see what you've written. This session is about getting your writing done and meeting other writers in your area.
Please arrive a few minutes early to say hello to everyone, grab a drink, and get your writing tools ready. Once everyone’s arrived, I will lead quick introductions and then set the timer for our quiet and focused writing session.
Afterward, we’ll have time to chat and get to know each other. We often talk about our successes and challenges as writers. If you don’t have time to stick around, no worries!
A note about the format We don’t host critiques or readings. These events are a safe space for writers of all skill levels and genres to work on their craft, so no one will read or critique your writing.
For our full event schedule, visit https://shutupwrite.com

item.title: Gaming Night @ Noble Cider — Tue Jan 19, 6:00 PM
item.description:
Asheville's Bored Game Geeks Roll the dice and pour a glass! 🎲🍎
Gaming Night is back at Noble Cider! Join us every other Tuesday for a night of tabletop tactics, card-shuffling chaos, and great company. Whether you’re a seasoned strategist or you still think a "meeple" is a type of small fruit, you’re welcome at our table.
### The Lowdown:
* **No Experience? No Problem:** We’re all about community. We’ll help you learn the ropes of a new game or cheer you on while you figure it out. * **The Library:** We have a solid stash of games ready to play—from quick party favorites to deeper strategy titles. * **Bring Your Favorites:** Have a game gathering dust on your shelf? Bring it along! We love seeing what the community is playing. * **The Vibe:** High-quality cider, cozy atmosphere, and just the right amount of competitive spirit.
**Feel Free to bring your own games too!**
Source: Asheville's Bored Game Geeks

item.title: Come sing with us! Vocal workshop and rehearsal - Land Of The Sky Chorus — Tue Jan 19, 6:30 PM
item.description:
Asheville Area A Cappella Singers Whether you are an experienced singer, or just like to sing in your car, come join us as our guest! The Land of The Sky Chorus, located in Asheville, NC, is welcoming guests - men and women - who are interested in joining us in the world-wide community of a cappella singing.
No experience is required; we provide music, voice training and an enjoyable singing experience under expert leadership. Our repertoire of music is fun and spans many styles - most songs are easy to learn and sing. Learning materials are provided to help you get started, and you will be paired with a singing "Buddy" so you can join in right away.
We will be here to greet you as early as 6:15pm to help you get situated.

item.title: Ask About Our Featured Listings — Wed Nov 11 — LiveMusicAsheville.com
item.description:
Established in February 2019, LiveMusicAsheville.com now reaches thousands of people every week actively searching for live music in the Asheville area. Roughly 60% of our traffic comes from Google Search as we dominate the top of the results for queries such as “Asheville live music” & “live music Asheville”. Meanwhile our direct traffic is experiencing explosive growth, proving more locals are now using us as their go-to music calendar. Our free listings include just the basics of Who’s Playin’ Where & When. Our Featured Listings really stand out among the dozens of events on the calendar every day. While we update every Wednesday for the following Friday thru Thursday, these Featured Listings are published much sooner and include your picture or poster, a description of the event and the venue, website/ticket links and a Google map. We also share these events on our social media stories to help further promote your show.
Source: LiveMusicAsheville.com
